description: Shared core exact-tenant media-perception scratch worker. The perception CLI commands (see/listen/watch) normalize media into a scratch dir on the persisted scope's own tier partition — the write side is admitted by the tmp/cache default_allow, but reads on protected tiers need an authorized identity. This role gives the STT/OCR bridge stage and the --index/--search semantic-index stage of that command the same effective identity the claimed-WorkItem path already has: read+write on active/shared/tmp/{confidential,personal}/${KYBERION_TENANT}/ and active/shared/staging/{confidential,personal}/${KYBERION_TENANT}/, plus the semantic index subtree active/shared/cache/{confidential,personal}/${KYBERION_TENANT}/perception/ only (never the rest of the cache floor), bound to the scope's own tenant. It never reads knowledge/, other tenants, other partitions, or system floors.
